title: Transport of a tensor tower through recorded transition equalities
statement: Let I be a preorder, C_i categories, R_h transition functors with specified composition isomorphisms a_hk, U_i binary tensor functors, and c_h normalized scalar comparisons satisfying the component tensor tower equation. Let S be a stage system on the same categories with S.T_h=R_h and S.assoc_hk heterogeneously equal to a_hk. Then conjugating each c_h by the equality isomorphisms S.T_h≅R_h gives FamilyTower S S S U, in the terminology of [lem-pur-bilinear-comparison-coefficient-descent]. No directedness, linearity, or object hypothesis is needed.

source.place: FamilyTower definition, and the transport step of lem-weil-rational-tensor-stage-coherence

proof.text: Destructure S. Function extensionality identifies its transition family with R; substitute this equality. The heterogeneous associator equalities become ordinary equalities, and function extensionality identifies the associator family with a. Substitute again. Unfold FamilyTower. The equality isomorphisms are reflexive; the product and whiskering component formulas cancel the identity arrows. The result is exactly the assumed component tower equation. Unfold TensorTowerDatum.Coherent only after the categories are abstract; its component equation is exactly the required one.

proof_origin.place: FamilyTower, extensional transport of stage-system data

theorem familyTower_of_transport
    {I : Type*} [Preorder I] {C : I → Type*} [∀ i, Category (C i)]
    (R : ∀ {i j : I}, i ≤ j → C i ⥤ C j)
    (a : ∀ {i j k : I} (h : i ≤ j) (k : j ≤ k), R h ⋙ R k ≅ R (h.trans k))
    (U : ∀ i, C i × C i ⥤ C i)
    (c : ∀ {i j : I} (h : i ≤ j), U i ⋙ R h ≅ (R h).prod (R h) ⋙ U j)
    (tower : ∀ {i j k : I} (h : i ≤ j) (hk : j ≤ k),
      (@TensorTowerDatum.mk (C i) (C j) (C k) (inferInstance : Category (C i))
        (inferInstance : Category (C j)) (inferInstance : Category (C k))
        (U i) (U j) (U k) (R h) (R hk) (R (h.trans hk))
        (a h hk) (c h) (c hk) (c (h.trans hk))).Coherent)
    (S : StageSystem C) (hR : ∀ {i j : I} (h : i ≤ j), S.T h = R h)
    (ha : ∀ {i j k : I} (h : i ≤ j) (k : j ≤ k), HEq (S.assoc h k) (a h k)) :
    BilinearCoefficientDescent.FamilyTower S S S U (fun {_ _} h ↦
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft _ (eqToIso (hR h)) ≪≫ c h ≪≫
        Functor.isoWhiskerRight
          (NatIso.prod (eqToIso (hR h)).symm (eqToIso (hR h)).symm) _)
